risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI Agent Adversarial & Red Team Testing, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25), Adversarial Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attack (MT-29).

compensating_control_1.name: AI Agent Governance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure AI agents are designed, developed and deployed to securely operate under human oversight.
compensating_control_1.justification: AI Agent Governance (AAT-39) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Adversarial & Red Team Testing (AAT-39.14) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Adversarial & Red Team Testing (AAT-39.14) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
